confidence_explanation: The evidence shows a clear pattern of an insider threat (user_04) performing extensive data exfiltration. The user, a junior accountant with read-only access, accessed and downloaded a massive volume of files far exceeding their baseline, specifically targeting multiple departments (HR, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, Legal, Security) that are entirely outside their scope of work.

attack_chain.description: User_04 logs in during off-hours (08:12) from their normal IP.
User_04 begins downloading large volumes of finance files, exceeding their daily average.
User_04 expands scope to the HR department, downloading sensitive YAML files.
User_04 accesses shared project data in the Engineering/Project Beta directory.
User_04 accesses the Sales department directory.
User_04 accesses the Marketing department directory.
User_04 accesses the Engineering department directory.
User_04 accesses the Legal department directory.
User_04 accesses the Sales department again.
User_04 accesses the Security department directory.

gaps: Lack of information regarding whether user_04 had a legitimate business reason or a support ticket for this cross-departmental access.
No information on whether the 'read_only' access level was bypassed or if the user had elevated permissions not reflected in the baseline.
narrative: User_04, a junior accountant, engaged in a massive data exfiltration event by accessing and downloading files from nearly every department in the organization, including HR, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, Legal, and Security. This behavior is highly anomalous compared to their baseline of only accessing finance files and represents a significant insider threat incident.
